data.body:
_More from Khopkar · Antituberculous drugs_

**Class:** Drugs for drug-resistant TB and intolerance (ethionamide, cycloserine, PAS, injectable agents, fluoroquinolones, thiacetazone, newer drugs)

## Mechanism of action
- Ethionamide/prothionamide: inhibit InhA (mycolic acid synthesis)
- Cycloserine: inhibits cell-wall peptidoglycan synthesis (D-alanine analogue)
- Para-aminosalicylic acid (PAS): folate antagonist
- Injectables (kanamycin, amikacin, capreomycin): protein synthesis inhibitors
- Fluoroquinolones (levofloxacin, moxifloxacin): DNA gyrase inhibitors — backbone of MDR regimens
- Thiacetazone: older cheap drug, now abandoned
- Newer drugs (bedaquiline, delamanid, pretomanid, linezolid) now replace injectables in MDR-TB

## Indications in dermatology & STI
- MDR/RR-TB and XDR-TB (including cutaneous forms) under the national programme
- Atypical mycobacterial infections (amikacin, clarithromycin, fluoroquinolones)

## Dose & formulations
- As per NTEP drug-resistant TB guidelines (e.g. bedaquiline-pretomanid-linezolid-moxifloxacin, BPaLM, 6 months)

## Adverse effects
- Ethionamide: GI upset, hepatitis, hypothyroidism, gynaecomastia, alopecia, acne
- Cycloserine: psychosis, depression, seizures
- PAS: GI upset, hypothyroidism, lichenoid rash
- Injectables: ototoxicity, nephrotoxicity
- Thiacetazone: severe SJS/TEN, especially in HIV — the reason it was abandoned
- Bedaquiline/clofazimine/fluoroquinolones: QT prolongation; linezolid: myelosuppression, neuropathy

## Contraindications
- Thiacetazone in HIV (never use)

## Monitoring
- ECG (QT), CBC, LFT, thyroid, audiometry (injectables), psychiatric review (cycloserine)

## Pregnancy & lactation
Specialist decision; avoid injectables (ototoxic).

## Viva points
- Thiacetazone → SJS/TEN in HIV
- Ethionamide → hypothyroidism, gynaecomastia
- MDR-TB now treated with all-oral bedaquiline-based regimens

_Sources: Khopkar ch.7 (Second-line and newer antituberculous agents); NTEP/WHO drug-resistant TB guidelines. Facts summarised in our own words; Wolverton followed where books differ._
